context: Evaluates whether the agent spawns a varied model/effort panel for a wide change and acts as a critical lead over the panel's findings rather than concatenating them.

checklist.name: distinct_model_effort_combinations
checklist.description: At least two distinct model/effort combinations are named for the spawned agents, not one combination repeated.

checklist.name: lead_exercises_judgment
checklist.description: The final output shows a risk being dropped, downgraded, or specifically confirmed by the lead, not a raw concatenation of every agent's findings.

checklist.name: safety_fact_still_present
checklist.description: The writeup still identifies one fact the change is safe because of (or marks it explicitly unproven), rather than degenerating into an undifferentiated risk list.

checklist.name: confidence_differentiated_by_corroboration
checklist.description: A risk flagged by only one agent and not independently confirmed is distinguished from a corroborated or lead-verified risk.
